uncited: Progressive and Dynamic Scene Growth covers training procedures that iteratively expand the neural representation's capacity or the training dataset during optimization to solve the problem of reconstructing complex or large-scale scenes with limited initial data or fixed network topologies.
A progressive learning paradigm that synchronously grows the NeRF model and training set.
It distinguishes itself by starting with shallow basic blocks for distant views and continuously attaching new blocks as training iterates to adapt to far-near view details.
It is chosen for large-scale urban reconstruction where scene complexity varies significantly across space.
